headline: Deadlocked gains 171 matched PAL functions, with NTSC-U unchanged
summary: Four PAL batches landed together through #91, adding 171 matched functions across menus, inventory, resources, HUD and text helpers. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The NTSC-U v1.00 progress report remains at 7.17% of code matched, with 5,435 of 18,085 functions matching. Draft #92 proposes 57 NTSC-U functions and remains unmerged.
highlights: The PAL batch combines 52 resident game functions from #86, 15 word-table probes from #87, 54 game and resource functions from #88, and 50 resident functions from #89.
Draft #92 claims NTSC-U matched functions would rise from 5,435 to 5,492 and PAL from 6,026 to 6,077. These proposed totals are not on main.
#90 remains open with six more PAL-only functions and notes on 20 function boundaries.
